description: Update an existing product. Pass only the fields to change. Changes price, name or publication of a product, keeping its productId — changing the id would break checkout flows already wired into the app.

anyOf.description: PRIVATE CONTENT the buyer gets beside its files (one_time: for good; subscription: while it lives): a link (a Canva template, a hidden video, a Discord invite) or a short text (a code, instructions). Never in the public catalogue; the buyer reads it with neblla.media.mine() (`content`). Neblla controls who sees it, not whether the buyer passes it on

label.description: What the button says, e.g. "Abrir en Canva" or { es, en }

text.description: Up to 2000 characters: a code, access instructions

content.description: Private content (replaces the whole list; null or [] takes it away). See neblla_create_product

currency.description: ISO 4217 code Stripe charges in, e.g. "usd"; the price is checked again in it

interval.description: subscription: how often it renews (new subscribers)

name.description: Product name, string or { en: "...", es: "..." }

price.description: Price in cents (one_time; per period for subscription — applies to new subscribers)

productId.description: The product ID returned by neblla_create_product

published.description: Whether the product is buyable (without an active payout account it waits, as in neblla_create_product)

seller.description: Who is paid for it: "site:<id>" or "user:<id>"; null: the app again. See neblla_create_product

anyOf.description: Physical product (one_time or consumable): where it ships and the postage of each zone

amount.description: Postage in cents (the product's currency); 0 is free

name.description: What the buyer sees at the checkout, e.g. "España" or "Resto de Europa"

shipping.description: Physical: the zones it ships to (replaces them all); null: no longer shipped

stock.description: Units for sale in all (one_time and consumable); null removes the limit. What is sold stays counted: lowering it below that leaves none

stockRefundReturns.description: Whether a refunded unit goes back on sale

name: neblla_update_product
title: Update product
